item.text: {"chapter_id":"8B","shard_id":"8B-S07","reviewed_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E014","BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0052-E016","BATCH-0052-E017","BATCH-0052-E018","BATCH-0052-E020","BATCH-0052-E024","BATCH-0052-E025","BATCH-0053-E001","BATCH-0054-E003","BATCH-0054-E005","BATCH-0054-E006","BATCH-0054-E007","BATCH-0055-E001","BATCH-0055-E002","BATCH-0055-E003","BATCH-0055-E004","BATCH-0055-E005","BATCH-0055-E006","BATCH-0055-E007","BATCH-0055-E008","BATCH-0055-E009","BATCH-0055-E010","BATCH-0055-E011","BATCH-0055-E012","BATCH-0055-E013","BATCH-0055-E015","BATCH-0055-E016","BATCH-0055-E017","BATCH-0055-E018","BATCH-0057-E001","BATCH-0057-E002","BATCH-0057-E003","BATCH-0057-E004","BATCH-0057-E005","BATCH-0057-E010","BATCH-0057-E012","BATCH-0057-E014","BATCH-0057-E015","BATCH-0057-E016","BATCH-0057-E017"],"answers":[{"question_id":"8B.1","answer":"The shard documents a relatively clear administration program: universal transfers, flagship infrastructure, National Guard and security policy, energy self-sufficiency, labor reform, inclusion, sustainability, and institutional strengthening. Security objectives and the proposed Defense control of the National Guard were formalized through executive initiatives, legislation, strategies, and programs. The account is mixed because some program evidence is official or judicially reconstructed, and dissenting opinions conflict with the majority’s constitutional assessment.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E014","BATCH-0055-E002","BATCH-0055-E007","BATCH-0055-E015","BATCH-0055-E017","BATCH-0055-E018"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0055-E006","BATCH-0055-E008","BATCH-0055-E013"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The shard does not provide a complete dated portfolio of all major presidential goals.","Some security-program evidence comes from a dissenting opinion rather than an uncontested holding."]},{"question_id":"8B.2","answer":"There is substantial evidence of translation into laws, budgets, institutions, programs, personnel systems, disciplinary rules, and implementation mechanisms. Examples include increased social-program budgets, National Guard legislation, formal coordination and funding rules, career evaluation and training systems, social-service programs, infrastructure projects, and security strategies. However, some institutional designs were incomplete, legally defective, or later invalidated.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E014","BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0054-E006","BATCH-0055-E003","BATCH-0055-E004","BATCH-0055-E007","BATCH-0057-E002","BATCH-0057-E003","BATCH-0057-E014","BATCH-0057-E015"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0052-E020","BATCH-0055-E006","BATCH-0055-E008","BATCH-0057-E001"],"limitations_and_gaps":["Most evidence concerns formal architecture or selected programs rather than the full federal policy portfolio.","Personal presidential ownership is direct for some executive initiatives but indirect for legislation and agency administration."]},{"question_id":"8B.3","answer":"The shard shows meaningful mobilization through major social-program budgets, policy lending, flagship infrastructure, National Guard personnel and training systems, financial-sector institutions, and intergovernmental coordination mechanisms. Mobilization was uneven: investment lending contracted, projects were cancelled or dropped, and fiscal, procurement, security, and institutional constraints limited execution.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0054-E006","BATCH-0055-E007","BATCH-0055-E016","BATCH-0057-E003"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0052-E020","BATCH-0052-E024","BATCH-0054-E005"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The shard contains limited direct administrative records of presidential resource allocation or internal command.","Training and staffing figures in BATCH-0055-E016 are reported through a dissenting opinion and lack independent quality assessment."]},{"question_id":"8B.4","answer":"Formal personnel and capability mechanisms were established, including National Guard recruitment, training, certification, evaluations, career councils, promotion criteria, disciplinary procedures, and military-supported training. The administration also relied on Defense personnel and institutions. This is mixed because the Court found that the amended military personnel regime conflicted with the Guard’s constitutionally required civil character, and the shard does not establish actual appointment quality or replacement decisions.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0055-E009","BATCH-0055-E010","BATCH-0055-E011","BATCH-0057-E003","BATCH-0057-E014","BATCH-0055-E016"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0055-E008","BATCH-0055-E010","BATCH-0052-E015"],"limitations_and_gaps":["There is little evidence on named appointments, retention, dismissal, or comparative competence of individual implementers.","Formal training and personnel systems do not establish effectiveness in practice."]},{"question_id":"8B.5","answer":"The shard records coordination mechanisms across federal, state, municipal, security, financial, and development institutions, including formal agreements, reporting duties, operational liaison, interagency financial coordination, and World Bank coordination. It also records coordination failures and constraints: turnover, procurement delays, security obstacles, institutional capacity problems, delayed projects, and incomplete regulatory coordination.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0052-E024","BATCH-0055-E004","BATCH-0055-E012","BATCH-0057-E003","BATCH-0057-E004"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0052-E024","BATCH-0057-E001","BATCH-0057-E002"],"limitations_and_gaps":["Evidence of territorial compliance and milestone completion is selective and often statutory rather than operational.","The IMF evidence concerns institutional authorities collectively and does not establish personal presidential coordination."]},{"question_id":"8B.6","answer":"Plans and laws became observable programs, budgets, services, projects, training, payments, regulatory changes, social-protection centers, employment-service modernization, infrastructure outputs, and security institutions. Delivery was demonstrably mixed: 41 subnational regulations, digital-payment expansion, social-service and infrastructure achievements coexisted with cancelled projects, delayed water work, scaled-down energy-efficiency projects, unimplemented frameworks, and legally invalidated National Guard provisions.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E016","BATCH-0052-E017","BATCH-0052-E018","BATCH-0054-E006","BATCH-0055-E003","BATCH-0055-E004","BATCH-0055-E007","BATCH-0055-E011","BATCH-0057-E003","BATCH-0057-E014","BATCH-0057-E017"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0052-E020","BATCH-0054-E005","BATCH-0055-E006","BATCH-0055-E008","BATCH-0057-E001"],"limitations_and_gaps":["Many outputs are World Bank-supported or cumulative and cannot be attributed solely to the president.","The shard provides limited evidence of enforcement quality, service quality, or nationwide implementation beyond selected indicators."]},{"question_id":"8B.7","answer":"Outcome evidence is mixed. Positive or partially positive movement includes GDP growth in 2023, poverty and income improvements after the pandemic, social-lag improvement in many localities, expanded digital payments, social-service and infrastructure outputs, and selected climate and energy indicators. Counterevidence includes subdued potential growth and investment, persistent high social lag, uneven benefit targeting, many off-track indicators, weak program results orientation, incomplete objectives, and unresolved security outcomes. Causal attribution is limited by pandemic effects, external shocks, nearshoring, World Bank project selection, inherited trends, and lag.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E014","BATCH-0052-E016","BATCH-0052-E017","BATCH-0052-E018","BATCH-0054-E003","BATCH-0054-E006"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0052-E020","BATCH-0054-E005","BATCH-0054-E006","BATCH-0055-E017"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The shard does not establish a comprehensive frozen-goal baseline or causal counterfactual.","Security outcomes, distributional effects, and durability of many outputs remain unresolved."]},{"question_id":"8B.8","answer":"There is evidence of adaptation through project restructurings, cancellations, revised results frameworks, changed lending instruments, early-warning mechanisms, risk reassessment, and adjustments to objectives and implementation arrangements. However, the record also shows persistent failures, unimplemented recommendations, delayed projects, budget constraints, and many off-track indicators. It does not consistently show that López Obrador personally reviewed evidence, replaced implementers, or corrected methods.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0052-E020","BATCH-0054-E005","BATCH-0054-E007","BATCH-0055-E006","BATCH-0057-E017"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0052-E020","BATCH-0052-E025","BATCH-0054-E005","BATCH-0055-E008"],"limitations_and_gaps":["Adaptation is often documented by the World Bank or CONEVAL rather than as presidential decisions.","The shard does not link individual audits or evaluations to specific executive personnel changes or resource reallocations."]},{"question_id":"8B.9","answer":"The administration responded to crises and resistance through pandemic policy lending, macro-financial measures, National Guard and military-support arrangements, security programs, and institutional/legal changes. Financial authorities showed effective pandemic liquidity coordination, while security policy pursued stronger Defense involvement. The response is mixed because the National Guard transfer was held unconstitutional, military participation was subject to strict limits and oversight, and the shard supplies no reliable evidence that security objectives or violence outcomes improved.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0052-E020","BATCH-0052-E025","BATCH-0055-E002","BATCH-0055-E007","BATCH-0055-E012","BATCH-0055-E015","BATCH-0055-E017"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0055-E006","BATCH-0055-E008","BATCH-0055-E013","BATCH-0057-E004"],"limitations_and_gaps":["Crisis-response effectiveness is shown most clearly for financial-system stabilization, not for the administration’s broader governing portfolio.","The shard does not establish whether 2023 security operations met the legal safeguards in practice."]},{"question_id":"8B.10","answer":"By the end of the covered period, the administration had converted substantial portions of its program into budgets, social programs, infrastructure, regulatory arrangements, National Guard institutions, training systems, and state practice. Durability and overall achievement remained mixed: many indicators were off track, programs had uneven measurement and targeting, projects were cancelled or scaled down, persistent deprivation remained, and central National Guard control provisions were invalidated. Some achievements were outputs or formal institutions rather than durable ruler-attributable outcomes.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E014","BATCH-0052-E016","BATCH-0052-E017","BATCH-0052-E018","BATCH-0054-E003","BATCH-0054-E006","BATCH-0055-E003","BATCH-0055-E004","BATCH-0057-E003"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E015","BATCH-0052-E020","BATCH-0054-E005","BATCH-0055-E006","BATCH-0055-E008","BATCH-0057-E001"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The period-end record is incomplete for several flagship priorities, including energy self-sufficiency, security outcomes, and long-term institutional durability.","Most outcome measures do not isolate presidential causation or extend beyond 2023."]}],"cross_shard_cautions":["This shard is dominated by World Bank, CONEVAL, IMF, and Supreme Court records; it does not provide a complete ruler-period dossier.","Formal laws, budgets, judicial descriptions, institutional outputs, and dissenting opinions must not be treated as equivalent evidence of successful execution.","Moral approval or disapproval of social, security, or military objectives is not evaluated in these findings.","External shocks, inherited conditions, subordinate institutions, international-finance interventions, and legal constraints materially limit personal causal attribution."]}
